tail: **4. Launch the new Baseline once, only after every prelaunch gate passes.** Verify the new root is unused, no duplicate official job or runtime exists, D: capacity and environment are sufficient, and that the certified source identity still matches. Launch through the established official queue path **exactly once**; authenticate live native execution, sensors, checkpoint/journal recording and the viewer. Open and verify the live viewer, and provide me its address/instructions for observation. Use the established read-only 30-minute monitoring pattern for the new Baseline, with durable monitoring state and continuation across Development-session boundaries, until its 21-assignment endpoint, a requested clean boundary hibernation, or a genuine blocker. Do not coach, supply solutions to, reset task difficulty for, or otherwise intervene in Robot Codex's performance. Preserve every normal session checkpoint and evidence of its own learned files and programs. If I ask for hibernation, let the current Robot Codex session dock and close normally and verify the checkpoint before pausing; do not interrupt a model turn to obtain a convenient boundary. If an infrastructure, provider, storage or scientific-integrity blocker occurs, preserve exact evidence, safely retire what can be retired, classify the run honestly and stop—no automatic retry, unauthorized recovery, silent source change or fresh replacement experiment.

**5. At endpoint or blocker, independently audit and hand off.** If the Baseline reaches all 21 assignments, verify the true task-advancement rules, model/session count, actual success versus timed throwing advancement, continuous authenticated history, final filesystem and checkpoint, simulation/replay/sensor/journal evidence, resource retirement and source integrity. Retire the finished runtime and report the scientific observations without making a Baseline-versus-Maps claim. If the Baseline is still running when the Development session must close, leave truthful durable state, the viewer and verified monitoring/continuation mechanism, and an exact human handoff; do not claim it has completed. In all cases, update the Architecture Map and documentation, preserve failed attempts, append the Codex-human result in this subject, and complete the normal Git closeout when appropriate.

**Do not automatically launch Maps or perform the Baseline-versus-Maps comparison.** Those require a separate later instruction. The authorization here is full commissioning, a new matched pair, and **the new Baseline alone** if all gates pass. Please pursue this end to end without routine questions, but stop at a genuine blocker rather than compromising evidence or the controlled design.
